programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Avec son empire criminel en ruines, Red recrute Liz dans une mission visant à gagner de l'argent en livrant un nouveau Blacklister à la Task Force.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz et la Task Force se joignent à Red qui est à la recherche d'un milliardaire qui brille par ses exploits en tant que voleur d'œuvres d'art.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Des souvenirs du passé mettent Red sur le chemin d'un ennemi déterminé à détruire son empire criminel.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La Task Force poursuit un chasseur de primes employé pour rechercher les associés les plus proches de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red met la Task Force sur la piste d'un homme capable de manipuler les souvenirs, ce qui amène Liz à remettre en question ses propres expériences.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Alors que la Task Force enquête sur une série de fusillades suspectes, l'agent Ressler est perturbé par des pressions extérieures.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz et la Task Force recherchent un criminel jusque là insaisissable qui veut détruire certains des plus précieux trésors du monde.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Lorsque Red fournit des informations exclusives sur un terroriste international, il met Liz et la Task Force en compétition avec une unité rivale de la CIA.

programme.title: Middleman
programme.desc: Trois intrigues convergentes racontent l’histoire de contrebandiers, d'un tueur en série et de trafiquants de drogue. Un ancien trafiquant (Snipes) essaie de se ranger mais il tombe sur une cachette contenant des drogues volées. Dans le même temps, une banlieusarde d’âge moyen (Cybill Shepherd) cache un tempérament sadique et vicieux.

programme.title: Le Bagarreur
programme.desc: Charles Bronson joue un vrai dur dans ce film d’action musclé racontant l'histoire d'un vagabond qui participe à des combats de boxe durant la Grande Dépression. Chaney (Bronson), un solitaire malchanceux, saute dans un train à destination de la Nouvelle-Orléans où, dans la partie la plus mal famée de la ville, il essaie de se faire un peu d’argent comme il peut, c'est-à-dire avec ses poings. Chaney va trouver un escroc nommé Speed (James Coburn) et le persuade qu’il peut gagner beaucoup d’argent. Chaney gagne quelques matches clandestins difficiles à mains nues, mais Speed se montre imprudent avec l’argent gagné et se retrouve endetté vis-à-vis d’une bande de voyous, ce qui va obliger Chaney à disputer un dernier match avec Street, un homme monstrueux. Ce sera là un très long combat où tous les coups seront permis et que les fans de Bronson adoreront.

programme.title: Flic de Haut Vol
programme.desc: Un cambrioleur se fait passer pour un flic pour récupérer un diamant volé.

programme.title: Escape Game
programme.desc: Dans ESCAPE GAME, le nouveau film d'Adam Robitel (INSIDIOUS : LA DERNIERE CLE), six personnes n'ayant rien en commun se retrouvent enfermées dans un jeu et devront trouver les indices ou mourir.

programme.title: Underworld: Blood Wars
programme.desc: Selene, aidée de son allié David, est de retour pour faire régner l'ordre entre vampires et loups-garous. Un nouveau chef est apparu chez les Lycans, tandis que du côté des vampires, une ambitieuse recrue s'active...

programme.title: La 5Ème Vague
programme.desc: Quatre vagues d'attaques, chacune plus mortelle que la précédente, ont décimé la presque totalité de la Terre. Terrifiée, se méfiant de tout, Cassie est en fuite et tente désespérément de sauver son jeune frère. Alors qu'elle se prépare à affronter la cinquième vague, aussi inévitable que fatale, elle va faire équipe avec un jeune homme qui pourrait bien représenter son dernier espoir – si toutefois elle peut lui faire confiance…

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Après dix ans passés en prison, le « Conducteur » n'a qu'une seule idée en tête : venger le meurtre de son frère, survenu durant un braquage de banque. Désormais libre, il se lance dans sa mission meurtrière, mais se voit traqué par un flic sur le point de prendre sa retraite et par un redoutable tueur à gages. Le chasseur devient la proie, et le « Conducteur » comprend vite que la mort de son frère cache bien des mystères. La liste des responsables pourrait même être incomplète…

programme.desc: Dans ESCAPE GAME, le nouveau film d'Adam Robitel (INSIDIOUS : LA DERNIERE CLE), six personnes n'ayant rien en commun se retrouvent enfermées dans un jeu et devront trouver les indices ou mourir.

programme.title: Chevalier
programme.desc: Bien qu'il ne soit pas noble et donc qu'il n'ait pas le droit de participer aux joutes des chevaliers, l'intrépide William décide de prendre son destin en main en remplaçant au pied levé le seigneur dont il est l'écuyer, décédé tragiquement quelques jours avant le fameux tournoi qui doit réunir tous les chevaliers du territoire.

programme.title: Lake Placid 3
programme.desc: Un an après la mort de Sadie Bickerman, le garde-chasse Nathan Bickerman (Colin Ferguson) et un groupe de jeunes personnes vont devoir faire face à une bande de crocodiles affamés de chair humaine qui déclenchent une nouvelle vague de terreur et de sang.

programme.title: Mariage Explosif
programme.desc: Les membres d'une famille se confrontent à ce qui les déchire lors du mariage du fils aîné.

programme.title: Good Luck Chuck
programme.desc: La superstar de Hollywood Jessica Alba (Fantastic Four, Into The Blue) et le comique Dane Cook tiennent la vedette dans cette comédie romantique désopilante. Un homme qui a rompu avec celle qui fut longtemps sa petite amie est surpris d'apprendre qu'elle a décidé de se fiancer avec celui qu'elle vient de rencontrer. Il répète le modèle et des célibataires commencent à le fréquenter dans l'espoir de trouver M. Parfait.

programme.title: Crazy Dad
programme.desc: Un père immature débarque la veille des noces de son fils, qu'il n'a pas vu depuis des années, et entretient dès son arrivée d'exécrables rapports avec la mariée.

programme.title: Potins De Femmes
programme.desc: Dans la ville imaginaire de Chinquapin, en Louisiane, un mariage se prépare. La mariée s'appelle Shelby (Julia Roberts), une belle jeune femme têtue dont la mère très stricte, M'Lynn (Sally Field), est prête à tout pour elle. Dolly Parton à la chevelure imposante joue le rôle de Truvy, la propriétaire d'un salon de beauté qui est le centre non officiel de la ville. Parmi sa clientèle jamais en reste de potins, il y a Ouiser (Shirley MacLaine), la femme la plus riche et la plus méchante du coin, et Clairee (Olympia Dukakis), une élégante veuve plutôt sournoise. L'atmosphère s'anime avec l'arrivée d'une nouvelle jeune femme, Annelle (Daryl Hannah), une stagiaire un peu naïve avec ses lunettes de chat et son passé mystérieux. Ces six « magnolias de fer » forment un groupe de soutien et d'amitié et constituent un bon auditoire pour les blagues des unes et des autres malgré les aléas de l'existence et de l'amour dans une petite ville du sud.

programme.title: S.O.S Fantômes II
programme.desc: Après l'extermination totale de tous les revenants dans la ville de New York, la joyeuse équipe de S.O.S Fantômes reprend du service (après un chômage technique long de cinq ans) quand leur amie Dana découvre que son bébé Oscar est l'objet de phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: L'histoire de Matilda, jeune prodige, flanquée de parents abrutis et d'une directrice d'école terroriste, qui s'épanouira grâce à son institutrice.

programme.title: Ecole Paternelle
programme.desc: DADDY DAY CARE est une comédie hilarante sur des enfants contrôlant leur nid ! Lorsque les publicitaires Charlie (Eddie Murphy, Dr. Dolittle) et Phil (Jeff Garlin, émission TV 'Curb Your Enthusiasm') perdent leurs emplois en essayant de vendre des céréales de petit-déjeuner au goût de légumes, leurs femmes partent travailler. Mais lorsqu'ils réalisent qu'ils n'ont pas les moyens de maintenir leurs enfants à la très chic Académie Chapman dirigée par la vilaine Miss Harridan (Anjelica Huston, The Addams Family), Charlie et Phil deviennent propriétaires de 'Daddy Day Care'. Ces deux Messieurs Maman ne réalisent pas encore qu'ils viennent tout juste de commencer leurs aventures en babysitting ! L'excellent casting de DADDY DAY CARE inclut aussi Steve Zahn (Stuart Little), Regina King (Legally Blonde 2: Red, White and Blonde) et Kevin Nealon (Anger Management).

Dolly Parton à la chevelure imposante joue le rôle de Truvy, la propriétaire d'un salon de beauté qui est le centre non officiel de la ville. Parmi sa clientèle jamais en reste de potins, il y a Ouiser (Shirley MacLaine), la femme la plus riche et la plus méchante du coin, et Clairee (Olympia Dukakis), une élégante veuve plutôt sournoise. L'atmosphère s'anime avec l'arrivée d'une nouvelle jeune femme, Annelle (Daryl Hannah), une stagiaire un peu naïve avec ses lunettes de chat et son passé mystérieux. Ces six « magnolias de fer » forment un groupe de soutien et d'amitié et constituent un bon auditoire pour les blagues des unes et des autres malgré les aléas de l'existence et de l'amour dans une petite ville du sud.

programme.title: S.O.S Fantômes II
programme.desc: Après l'extermination totale de tous les revenants dans la ville de New York, la joyeuse équipe de S.O.S Fantômes reprend du service (après un chômage technique long de cinq ans) quand leur amie Dana découvre que son bébé Oscar est l'objet de phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: L'histoire de Matilda, jeune prodige, flanquée de parents abrutis et d'une directrice d'école terroriste, qui s'épanouira grâce à son institutrice.

programme.title: Ecole Paternelle
programme.desc: DADDY DAY CARE est une comédie hilarante sur des enfants contrôlant leur nid ! Lorsque les publicitaires Charlie (Eddie Murphy, Dr. Dolittle) et Phil (Jeff Garlin, émission TV 'Curb Your Enthusiasm') perdent leurs emplois en essayant de vendre des céréales de petit-déjeuner au goût de légumes, leurs femmes partent travailler. Mais lorsqu'ils réalisent qu'ils n'ont pas les moyens de maintenir leurs enfants à la très chic Académie Chapman dirigée par la vilaine Miss Harridan (Anjelica Huston, The Addams Family), Charlie et Phil deviennent propriétaires de 'Daddy Day Care'. Ces deux Messieurs Maman ne réalisent pas encore qu'ils viennent tout juste de commencer leurs aventures en babysitting ! L'excellent casting de DADDY DAY CARE inclut aussi Steve Zahn (Stuart Little), Regina King (Legally Blonde 2: Red, White and Blonde) et Kevin Nealon (Anger Management).

programme.title: Supergrave
programme.desc: Evan et Seth sont deux amis pas très futés qui ne peuvent pas se passer l'un de l'autre. Pourtant, il va bien falloir qu'ils apprennent, parce que cette année, ils sont inscrits dans deux universités différentes ! Evan est craquant, plutôt intelligent et constamment terrifié par la vie - et les filles en particulier.

programme.title: L'or de Curly
programme.desc: Mitch Robbins part avec son frère Glen, et son ami de toujours Phil Berquist à la recherche du trésor de Curly, un cowboys qu'il a connu autrefois.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam est engagé pour tourner une vidéo sur un match de football important contre les rivaux de William Penn. Beverly et Murray veulent acheter la maison d'un voisin pour que le clan des Goldberg reste ensemble.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Le cas difficile de sumac vénéneux de Barry crée des problèmes pour Erica et Geoff. Le fait que M. Glascott vive à côté constitue un défi pour les Goldberg.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.sub-title: The Hunt For The Great Albino Pumpkin
programme.desc: Adam est déçu par Halloween. Barry décide de redonner vie à son ancien alter ego, le rappeur "Big Tasty". Barry et Joanne rencontrent Elvira, Maîtresse de la nuit.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry et Geoff s’affrontent dans un concours de beauté sur le campus. Beverly a du mal à créer des liens avec ses nouveaux collègues à William Penn.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Jaloux lorsque Geoff invite Erica à l’enregistrement de leur émission télé préférée, Barry décide de se venger. Beverly suscite des doutes chez Adam quant à sa relation avec Brea.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Déterminée à déjouer son ennemie jurée, Beverly se met à vendre du maquillage pour une entreprise française. Lorsque les joueurs de NFL se mettent en grève, Barry décide de passer les tests pour les Eagles de Philadelphie et apprend des vérités surprenantes sur Murray.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Erica et Geoff affrontent Barry et Joanne pour voir quel est le meilleur couple. Adam trouve un travail pour prouver son indépendance à Brea.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam est engagé pour le premier rôle de la pièce de théâtre du lycée. Barry essaie de profiter de la séparation d’Erica et Geoff.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry convainc Geoff de participer à un jeu télévisé de rencontres pour oublier Erica. La surprise de Murray pour Beverly se retourne contre lui.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Murray aide Erica à se remettre de sa rupture avec Geoff. Adam prépare une blague d’élève de dernière année pour ancrer son héritage à William Penn.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Beverly encourage le principal Ball à créer une soirée pour les lycéens qui ne pratiquent pas l'athlétisme. Erica a du mal à nommer une personne qui organisera les réjouissances avant le mariage.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam apprend qu'il est admis à l'université, mais son enthousiasme diminue vite lorsqu'il comprend que Brea a été admise dans une école loin de là. Adam craint que la distance n'affecte leur relation.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Quand Linda Schwartz organise Thanksgiving, Beverly craint que son rôle d'hôtesse ne soit menacé. Pop-pop surprend la famille avec une nouvelle "copine".

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.sub-title: You Only Die Once, Or Twice, But Never Three Times
programme.desc: Beverly élabore un plan pour sauver le mariage de Formica Mike, qui bat de l'aile, mais ses efforts se retournent contre elle. Barry demande à Adam et ses amis de créer un film privé sur le thème de James Bond afin de courtiser Joanne.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Erica et Geoff décident d'organiser une fête pour prouver qu'ils savent toujours s'amuser en tant que jeune couple fiancé. Beverly insiste pour que l'école organise une fête d'adieu sur le thème de Fame pour la classe de terminale.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam et Brea avouent des secrets qui pourraient compromettre l'avenir de leur relation. Barry et Beverly explorent leur amour partagé de la danse sur glace.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Geoff et Joanne montrent un exemple gênant pour les Goldberg avec leur fête familiale de la Saint Valentin. Les efforts d'Adam pour sauver son amitié avec Brea se retournent contre lui.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry tombe sur ses ex et leurs copains pendant l'enterrement de vie de jeune fille et de garçon d'Erica et Geoff. Adam intervient lorsque Lou se charge d'organiser la vidéo du mariage.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: La veille de son mariage, Erica se rebelle contre les projets excessifs de Beverly pour le grand jour.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Pour éviter de passer les vacances de printemps avec sa mère, Adam accepte de garder l'appartement citadin d'Erica. Barry et les JTP tentent de devenir le prochain groupe tendance.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.sub-title: The Strangest Affair Of All Time
programme.desc: Quand Murray quitte la ville, Jane Bales tente de s'emparer de l'Empire ottoman, obligeant Beverly à riposter. Adam est enchanté d'apprendre que Dave Kim prévoit aussi d'aller à l'université de New York.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Alors que Beverly se met à enseigner la gym à l'école William Penn, Barry et Geoff s'affrontent pour un stage d'été très convoité.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: À l'occasion d'un voyage en Floride pour trier les affaires de Pops, Beverly découvre un grand secret. L'acte héroïque d'Erica au centre commercial éclipse les résultats aux examens d'admission à l'école de médecine de Barry.

programme.desc: Alors que la remise de diplôme d'Adam approche, Beverly hésite à rester comme surveillante d'école. Erica tente d'éviter le traditionnel dîner du dimanche des Schwartz.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Quand un problème de moisissures oblige Erica et Geoff à résider chez les Goldberg. Beverly ressent des tensions dans leur mariage et en profite pour donner quelques conseils conjugaux.

programme.title: Missing

programme.title: Missing

programme.title: Missing
programme.desc: Une star de la chanson et son ex veulent retrouver un bébé qu'ils ont remis à l'adoption six ans plus tôt.

programme.title: Missing
programme.desc: Jess et Nicole sont chargées de retrouver un huissier. Elle trouvent alors un homme disparu.

programme.desc: Lulu affronte les deux Fallin pour défendre le droit d'un homme sans abri à conserver une maison abandonnée.

programme.desc: Tandis que Skyler recommence à envisager positivement la cohabitation, Walt se demande s'il ne doit pas reprendre les affaires. Hank est si décidé à arrêter Heisenberg que Jesse est menacé.

programme.title: Breaking Bad
programme.desc: Walt reprend le travail dans le laboratoire de pointe de Gus. La découverte de leur ancien RV les oblige lui et Jesse à agir vite pour ne pas se faire prendre par Hank.

programme.title: Breaking Bad
programme.desc: Vexé que son dossier se soit désintégré avec la destruction du laboratoire mobile, Hank risque sa carrière en attaquant Jesse ; afin d'éviter que Jesse ne parle, Walt lui propose de refaire équipe dans son nouveau laboratoire.

programme.title: Breaking Bad
programme.desc: Tandis que Hank s'accroche à la vie après la tentative de meurtre par le cartel, Walt cherche à éviter davantage d'ennuis en s'associant à Jesse, avant de comprendre que les tueurs en avaient peut-être aussi après lui.

programme.title: Breaking Bad
programme.desc: Tandis qu'il reprend la production avec Walt, Jesse cherche le moyen d'augmenter ses parts. La guérison de Hank met Marie dans une situation d'assurance délicate.

programme.title: My Perfect Romance
programme.desc: Robinson Tech is launching a new dating service that they ensure will find your Perfect Match. But when its's CEO and tech developer are challenged on Live TV to test the service themselves, the algorithm shows some interesting results.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Charm
programme.desc: A young Amish woman, who isn't satisfied with her path at home, visits a cousin for the summer. Over the summer, she is exposed to another world, finds friendship and more. Soon she must choose and come to terms with the life she wants.

programme.title: Island of Grace
programme.desc: For Megan, matters of faith are to be hidden from her friends and coworkers. Her social life and the way she wants to live come first. But when she goes on a business trip with two coworkers- the arrogant office crush Mark, and the office nobody, Chris-her plane crashes, and she's forced to reexamine her life. Stranded on an island in a far corner of the world, Megan begins a journey not just of survival, but discovering herself and what really matters.

programme.title: Love in Tahiti
programme.desc: Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.

programme.title: Nowhere Safe
programme.desc: After two teen girls cruelly impersonate her online in a “reverse cyber bullying” plot, Ashley’s reputation is ruined and she and her mother Julie (a high school teacher) flee an escalating threat to their lives. Starting over at a new school, romantic interests and the poignant lessons from an eccentric history teacher draw them out of seclusion until they realize confronting a hurtful past is essential to ensure a brighter future.

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Ellie tends to the injured and cantankerous Jordan as he heals from a shoulder injury. Though he struggles to learn to use his arm again, his attitude leaves Ellie wanting to leave him in his misery. But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Love Switch
programme.desc: On their 13th wedding anniversary, James and Michelle wake up to discover they have somehow switched bodies. Unable to switch back, they are forced to understand what the other goes through daily.

programme.title: Love’s Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Horse Crazy Too
programme.desc: When a prize foal is stolen, two young siblings and their teenage babysitter must work together and catch the thieves before their family's ranch goes into foreclosure. A dangerous journey lies ahead, but with a little mountain magic, sometimes it pays to horse around!

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane: North America's greatest car show

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Amelia Island's own Caffeine & Octane car show,: Featuring $2,000 Wrek Racing Truck, David Patterson's favorite C&O cars, a plastic Citroen Mehari, and much more.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The Concours d'Elegance from Amelia Island: Featuring bomb-proof Conquest Knight XV, '69 Camaro Hagerty Fixer-Upper, and car-enthusiast John Oates.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengeance
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

Gary's wife Kim, their three boys and nephew embark on a Turkey hunt in Central Minnesota to chase after some gobblers. In addition to honoring Gary and chasing Turkeys, we discuss the Invisible wounds that our servicemen and women face daily while protecting their communities and our freedoms. programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Dan Schmidt struggles with freezing Nebraska temperatures on a whitetail rut hunt in the Sandhills.

programme.title: The Cast

Even though fishing is tough the guys build strong friendships and lasting memories.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners
programme.desc: In this episode the DCD crew heads to the lesser-known but highly productive Red River in Western Louisiana. Not to mention a handful of bonus squirrels and wild mushrooms. Shoot straight and come hungry.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners

Shoot straight and come hungry because it's the last hunt of the season.

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: Super Retriever

programme.title: Super Retriever

Only one team will rise above the rest to claim the Crown in this thrilling conclusion.

programme.title: Huntstand Presents
programme.desc: Massive wildfires had consumed thousands of acres across the Bighorn Mountains and the neighboring foothills. Would the annual HuntStand pronghorn camp be a total bust, or would the crew be able to find a few animals beyond the smoke?

programme.title: Huntstand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: Huntstand Presents
programme.desc: After several years of shifting focus back to his native whitetails, Dahlke returns to mule deer country with the Muley Freak, Erik Van Woerkom. Follow along on this Utah mule deer hunt.

programme.title: Huntstand Presents
programme.sub-title: HuntStand Presents - "Second Chance | Hunting the November Rut in Ohio"
programme.desc: Hunting has a way of grounding us, reminding us of what truly matters: shared moments and unforgettable memories. Chance and Ashleigh Eckert are on their first out-of-state hunt in the rolling hills of Ohio. After overcoming a life-changing kidney transplant, their story is one of faith, love, and resilience. While the goal was a big buck, the true reward was the time spent together and the lessons learned along the way. Because hunting is about so much more than the harvest — it’s about the journey.

programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: FishON! | Remote Escapes: Pike Frenzy and Hidden Lake Explorations
programme.desc: In the thrilling Season 7 finale, Paul & Perry and the team venture deep into Northern Ontario, using a Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake with high hopes for walleye. However, the day takes a surprising turn as Northern Pike steal the show with their spirited action. The adventure doesn’t end there—a bonus portage into another lake offers a chance to explore uncharted waters. It’s a fitting conclusion to a season filled with the unexpected and unforgettable.
